Name: Held Item Tooltips
Author: pneuma163
Description:
[size=5]What it is:[/size][size=3]
A simple UI mod that displays the name of the item you are holding for a few seconds. The name will appear above/below your toolbar, depending on whether the toolbar is at the top or bottom of the screen.

[/size][size=5]Config/Options:[/size][size=3]
I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to adjust this mod's configs.
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]You can change the distance from the toolbar that the name appears (the screenshot shows distance of 0, the default)[/size]
[*][size=3]You can change the scale of the font size (the screenshot shows 2.0 scale while the default is 1.0)[/size]
[*][size=3]You can change how long the name appears on screen (the default is 2.0 seconds)[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]How to install:[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]If you need additional help installing the mod, the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Valley wiki[/url]﻿ has more detailed instructions.
To uninstall the mod, delete this mod's folder from your Mods folder.

[url=https://codeberg.org/pneuma163/StardewValleyMods/src/branch/main/HeldItemTooltips]source code[/url]
[/size]
